title: MambaTrack: A Simple Baseline for Multiple Object Tracking with State Space Model
task: Online multi-object tracking (MOT), tracking-by-detection
modality: RGB video detections and bounding-box trajectories; the tracker uses detector outputs rather than RGB template-search matching
mamba_category: Mamba for temporal memory; Mamba for motion prediction; Mamba for low-light or adverse-condition tracking
what_mamba_models: Historical bounding-box trajectories, motion tokens, missing observations, and future object movement.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Motion prediction and tracklet recovery in online MOT using historical trajectory information.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Image restoration, RGB template-search degradation recovery, and response-map fusion are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Mamba is used for trajectory/motion modeling in MOT, not for restoring degraded visual target/search features.

title: Mamba-FETrack: Frame-Event Tracking via State Space Model
task: RGB-Event single-object visual tracking
modality: RGB frames plus event stream converted into event images
mamba_category: Mamba for multimodal fusion; Mamba as an efficient backbone; Mamba for low-light or adverse-condition tracking
what_mamba_models: RGB-frame and event-image features, cross-modal interaction, and template-search features.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Efficient RGB-event feature extraction and modality fusion for frame-event tracking.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: RGB-only restoration, image-level enhancement, and degradation-aware template update are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Robustness is sensor/fusion driven through RGB-event data, not restoration-oriented RGB recovery.

title: MambaIR: A Simple Baseline for Image Restoration with State-Space Model
task: Image restoration, including super-resolution, image denoising, real-world denoising, and JPEG compression artifact reduction.
modality: Single-image restoration from low-quality image input to high-quality image output; not video tracking.
mamba_category: Mamba for image restoration; Mamba as an efficient backbone
what_mamba_models: Image restoration features and 2D scanned image-token sequences for degradations such as denoising, super-resolution, and JPEG artifact reduction.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Single-image restoration under multiple image degradation tasks.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Tracking, template-search matching, temporal memory, and dynamic template update are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: This is restoration-oriented Mamba evidence, but it is not a tracking paper.

title: MambaLCT: Boosting Tracking via Long-term Context State Space Model
task: Visual object tracking with long-term video context.
modality: Visual template-search tracking from image/video frames. Use of language, thermal, event, or restoration modalities is not reported as an input to the method.
mamba_category: Mamba for temporal memory; Mamba for video-level context
what_mamba_models: Historical search-frame features, target-related hidden states, and propagated long-term context.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Long-term video context construction for visual object tracking.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Image degradation handling, restoration/enhancement, and degradation-aware memory update are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Evidence for Mamba temporal context/memory in tracking, not for restoration-oriented degradation robustness.

title: Exploring Enhanced Contextual Information for Video-Level Object Tracking
task: Video-level visual object tracking with contextual-information transmission.
modality: Visual object tracking using video clips/search regions. Use of non-RGB modalities, natural-language input, thermal input, event input, or restoration input is not reported for the method.
mamba_category: Mamba for temporal memory; Mamba for video-level context
what_mamba_models: Historical contextual information in CIF hidden states and current-frame contextual features.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Video-level contextual information transmission for tracking.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Image restoration, explicit degradation handling, and degradation-aware dynamic template update are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Mamba stores and updates context, but the card does not support degradation/restoration claims.

title: MM-Tracker: Motion Mamba for UAV-platform Multiple Object Tracking
task: UAV-platform multi-object tracking (MOT)
modality: RGB UAV video with detector features, motion maps, and MOT association; not RGB single-object template-search tracking
mamba_category: Mamba for motion prediction; Mamba for low-light or adverse-condition tracking; Mamba for degradation-aware feature learning
what_mamba_models: Motion maps, bi-temporal detector features, scanned feature maps, and feature-level motion interactions.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Motion modeling and blurred-object detection/association for UAV-platform MOT.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Visual feature restoration, RGB template-search degradation recovery, and image-level enhancement are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Mamba targets motion blur through feature/motion modeling rather than restoration.

title: Robust Tracking via Mamba-based Context-aware Token Learning
task: Visual object tracking with temporal context learned from track tokens.
modality: RGB-style visual template-search tracking from image pairs/video frames. Use of thermal, event, language, or restoration modalities is not reported.
mamba_category: Mamba for temporal memory; Mamba for video-level context
what_mamba_models: Historical track-token sequences, hidden states, current track tokens, and temporal context.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Robust temporal context learning from track tokens without image-selection template updates.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Image degradation handling, restoration/enhancement, and degradation-aware template update are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Mamba use is temporal token memory, not restoration or degradation recovery.

title: Multi-State Tracker: Enhancing Efficient Object Tracking via Multi-State Specialization and Interaction
task: Efficient single-object visual tracking
modality: RGB visual tracking
mamba_category: Mamba as an efficient backbone; Mamba for low-light or adverse-condition tracking
what_mamba_models: Multiple target feature states, state-specific enhanced representations, and cross-state interactions through HSA-SSD.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Efficient feature-state specialization and interaction for robust tracking in complex scenarios.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Degradation-state modeling, image restoration, and degradation-aware template/search recovery are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Multi-state means target feature states, not degradation states.

title: Hyperspectral Mamba for Hyperspectral Object Tracking
task: Hyperspectral single-object tracking
modality: Hyperspectral video plus false-color hyperspectral images
mamba_category: Mamba for temporal memory; Mamba for multimodal fusion; Mamba for dynamic template update; Mamba for low-light or adverse-condition tracking; Mamba for degradation-aware feature learning
what_mamba_models: Spectral hidden states, cross-depth spectral information, inter-frame temporal spectral information, and forward/backward/spectral scans.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Hyperspectral spectral-spatial-temporal modeling with dynamic template and hidden-state propagation.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: RGB-only restoration and generic RGB degradation-robust template-search tracking are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Robustness comes from hyperspectral spectral modeling and feature enhancement, not RGB image restoration.

title: All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracking
task: Multi-camera multi-target tracking
modality: RGBT, using visible RGB and infrared/thermal video
mamba_category: Mamba for multimodal fusion; Mamba for low-light or adverse-condition tracking
what_mamba_models: Visible RGB and infrared features guided by lighting-relevant information.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Adaptive RGBT feature fusion for all-day low-light MCMT.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: RGB-only template-search restoration and image-level low-light enhancement are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Low-light robustness is addressed through infrared/RGBT fusion, not RGB restoration.

title: MambaIRv2: Attentive State Space Restoration
task: Image restoration, including classic/lightweight super-resolution, JPEG compression artifact reduction, and Gaussian color image denoising.
modality: Single-image restoration from low-quality observations to high-quality images; not video or visual object tracking.
mamba_category: Mamba for image restoration
what_mamba_models: Restoration features, non-causal attentive state-space querying, and reordered image-token sequences for restoration.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Image restoration under super-resolution, JPEG artifact reduction, and denoising settings.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Tracking, template-search matching, temporal memory, and dynamic template update are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Strong restoration-oriented Mamba evidence, but not tracking-specific.

title: Exploring Historical Information for RGBE Visual Tracking with Mamba
task: RGB-Event single-object visual tracking, with additional RGB-T generalization experiments
modality: RGB plus event; additional experiments use visible plus thermal infrared
mamba_category: Mamba for temporal memory; Mamba for multimodal fusion; Mamba for target-aware scanning; Mamba for response-map or matching enhancement; Mamba for low-light or adverse-condition tracking
what_mamba_models: Template-search interaction, RGB-event modality fusion, historical temporal cues, target appearance changes, and motion trends.
problem_solved_by_mamba: RGB-event template-search interaction, modality-selective fusion, and historical tracking cue modeling.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: RGB-only image restoration, explicit degradation restoration, and degradation-aware template update are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Target-aware scanning and multimodal fusion are covered; restoration-oriented RGB recovery is not.

title: SportMamba: Adaptive Non-Linear Multi-Object Tracking with State Space Models for Team Sports
task: Online multi-object tracking for team sports
modality: RGB sports video detections, player tracklets, ReID appearance features, and motion predictions; not RGB single-object template-search tracking
mamba_category: Mamba for temporal memory; Mamba for motion prediction; Mamba for low-light or adverse-condition tracking
what_mamba_models: Bounding-box tracklet sequences, nonlinear player motion, lost-tracklet memory, and tracklet feature updates.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Adaptive nonlinear motion prediction and association for team-sports MOT.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Visual restoration, RGB template-search degradation handling, and image enhancement are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Mamba is motion/tracklet oriented, not visual restoration oriented.

title: MambaMOT: State-Space Model as Motion Predictor for Multi-Object Tracking
task: Multi-object tracking (MOT), tracking-by-detection motion prediction
modality: RGB-video MOT through detector outputs and bounding-box tracklets; the Mamba model operates on trajectory boxes, not RGB template-search pairs
mamba_category: Mamba for temporal memory; Mamba for motion prediction
what_mamba_replaces: Kalman filtering for MOT motion prediction.
what_mamba_models: Trajectory sequences, hidden states over tracklets, predicted boxes, and trajectory features.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Motion prediction in multi-object tracking using trajectory-sequence hidden states.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Image degradation, visual restoration, and RGB template-search matching are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Direct evidence that Mamba has been used as a Kalman-style motion predictor in MOT.

title: MambaTrack: Exploiting Dual-Enhancement for Night UAV Tracking
task: Night UAV single-object tracking with vision-language prompts
modality: RGB video plus language prompt
mamba_category: Mamba for image restoration; Mamba for multimodal fusion; Mamba as an efficient backbone; Mamba for low-light or adverse-condition tracking; Mamba for tracking-aware restoration
what_mamba_models: Low-light template/search image enhancement, visual features, language features, and cross-modal vision-language interactions.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Night UAV tracking through Mamba-based low-light enhancement and vision-language enhancement.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Generic degradation robustness beyond nighttime/low-light and language-free RGB restoration tracking are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Closest card to tracking-aware Mamba restoration, but scoped to low-light night UAV plus language prompts.

title: MambaVT: Spatio-Temporal Contextual Modeling for Robust RGB-T Tracking
task: RGB-T single-object visual tracking
modality: RGB plus thermal infrared (visible-thermal)
mamba_category: Mamba for temporal memory; Mamba for video-level context; Mamba for multimodal fusion; Mamba for dynamic template update; Mamba for low-light or adverse-condition tracking
what_mamba_models: Multimodal RGB-T template/search inputs, cross-frame templates, historical trajectory prompts, and online template memory.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Spatio-temporal contextual modeling for RGB-T tracking with template memory and trajectory prompts.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: RGB-only restoration and image-level degradation recovery are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Robustness is visible-thermal and temporal-context based, not RGB restoration based.

title: MambaNUT: Nighttime UAV Tracking via Mamba-based Adaptive Curriculum Learning
task: Nighttime UAV single-object tracking
modality: RGB video
mamba_category: Mamba as an efficient backbone; Mamba for low-light or adverse-condition tracking; Mamba for degradation-aware feature learning
what_mamba_replaces: ViT-style self-attention backbone pressure is the stated efficiency motivation; exact replacement is not reported.
what_mamba_models: Template/search patch tokens and robust feature representations under low-light nighttime UAV data.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Efficient nighttime UAV tracking with Vision Mamba and adaptive curriculum learning.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Image restoration/enhancement and generic degradation restoration are not part of the proposed method.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Low-light robustness is curriculum/backbone driven, not restoration driven.

title: MambaEVT: Event Stream-Based Visual Object Tracking Using State Space Model
task: Event-camera single-object visual tracking
modality: Event-only tracking using event streams converted into event images
mamba_category: Mamba for temporal memory; Mamba for dynamic template update; Mamba as an efficient backbone; Mamba for low-light or adverse-condition tracking; Mamba for response-map or matching enhancement
what_mamba_models: Event template/search features, short-term and long-term memory libraries, and dynamic template sequences.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Event-only tracking with efficient feature extraction and Memory Mamba dynamic template generation.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: RGB-only degradation restoration and image-level enhancement are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Dynamic template memory is covered, but in event-only tracking rather than RGB restoration.

title: SMTrack: State-Aware Mamba for Efficient Temporal Modeling in Visual Tracking
task: Visual object tracking with efficient temporal modeling.
modality: RGB visual tracking. The paper explicitly contrasts SMTrack with MambaVT for RGB-T tracking.
mamba_category: Mamba for temporal memory; Mamba for video-level context; Mamba for dynamic template update; Mamba for target-aware scanning; Mamba for response-map or matching enhancement
what_mamba_models: Saved template hidden states, current search interactions, state-aware scanned templates, and multi-frame propagation.
problem_solved_by_mamba: Efficient temporal modeling, hidden-state memory, and dynamic template hidden-state updates for RGB tracking.
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Restoration/enhancement and image-degradation tracking in the restoration sense are not reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Strong evidence for Mamba memory/template update; not evidence for restoration-oriented degradation recovery.

title: InvTrack: Efficient Deep Object Tracking Neural Network with Invariant Feature Learning
task: Single-object visual object tracking under image-quality degradation.
modality: RGB/video template-search tracking with clean and synthetically degraded template/search samples during training.
mamba_category: not reported
what_mamba_models: not reported
problem_solved_by_mamba: not reported
problem_not_solved_by_mamba: Mamba usage is not reported in the card; degradation-invariant tracking is handled by non-Mamba modules.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Use as non-Mamba degradation-invariant tracking evidence, not as a Mamba usage example.
